title: The Long Tablecloth
youtube_title: The Long Tablecloth | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A fiddly job goes well when two people take slow halves.
summary: At a school hall being set for a gentle fair, a tablecloth that ballooned if you shook it alone will go wrong if one person rushes. Quinn and Jaleh split it into two slow jobs, while Grandpa Sol only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
